title: character profiles
description: A character profile editor and viewer for multiplayer communities
body:
This is a multiplayer compatable Profile Viewer and Editor for community servers. This was commissioned by [A fiver artist](https://www.fiverr.com/ryankshah/make-you-a-minecraft-mod-in-forge-neoforge-or-fabric?source=order_page_summary_gig_link_title&funnel=b81d0a2341e64787841aa1b7b6e06ecd) for use on my [Astral Arise](https://modrinth.com/modpack/astral-arise-rp) modpack.

You can:
- View players profile with /profile lookup [playername]
- edit your existing profile with /profile
- create a profile using /profile create [name] and follow the in chat instructions
- hide information with buttons to hide stats from other players.
